modules.name: catalog/velocity
./rows

defs.doc:
Trailing-window counts, the 24-hour amount sum and the 24-hour count of
distinct merchants, for events sorted by (user, ts), current instant excluded.
Two left pointers per user, one per window; a count per merchant tracks the
distinct merchants as rows enter and leave the 24-hour window.
The sum is taken afresh over the window, left to right, so it is the same
float a plain loop over the window gives, not a running total that drifts.
user  the entity key, sorted ascending
ts  event time, int64 nanoseconds, ascending within a user
amount  the event's amount
merchant  the merchant of the event, any Int
@ c2d7b628
defs.intent: Trailing-window counts, the 24-hour amount sum and the 24-hour count of distinct merchants, for events sorted by (user, ts), current instant excluded.

steps.text: rows before the instant enter the windows
rows older than the windows leave them
every row of the instant sees the same windows
clear the merchant counts the user left behind

loops.head: for j from left_24h to i
for k from i to same
for j from left_24h to entered

defs.doc:
The end (exclusive) of the key group that starts at row `start`, after
checking that the rows are sorted by (key, ts); `who` names the caller in
the error.
key  the entity key of each row
ts  each row's time, int64 nanoseconds
start  the first row of the group
@ 2c0afca7
defs.intent: The end (exclusive) of the key group that starts at row `start`, after checking that the rows are sorted by (key, ts); `who` names the caller in the error.

loops.head: while stop_at < n and key[stop_at] == key[start]
